claim: All three branches use the published Kaalka 5.0.0 algorithm; the local byte bridges are byte-equivalent to the published packages
why_a_bridge_exists: The published packages' public byte APIs route ciphertext through utf8.decode/encode, which is lossy for arbitrary binary; each branch therefore mirrors the package's _proc byte transform exactly (same formula, same h%12 time parsing) to obtain a lossless byte path. The pub.dev Kaalka registry class is still instantiated as a declared dependency.

javascript_vs_npm.method: direct _proc comparison (npm kaalka 5.0.0 installed fresh vs src/crypto/kaalkaV5Client.ts)

dart_vs_pubdev.method: published Kaalka.encrypt(List<int>) with ASCII-safe designed vectors vs lib/src/crypto/kaalka_v5_proc.dart, plus source-level identity of _proc in pub cache kaalka-5.0.0
